name: AskHemant 01 · Kit sign-up → Pipeline + WhatsApp (case study #0)

nodes.name: Tally webhook
nodes.notes: Tally form (askhemant.ai/kit calculator) → Integrations → Webhooks → this Production URL. Add a signing secret in Tally and the same value as TALLY_SIGNING_SECRET in n8n.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit the values here (or replace the {{TOKENS}} in the JSON before import). Non-secret settings only.

nodes.name: Verify + normalise
nodes.notes: Checks the Tally-Signature header, then turns the Tally payload into one clean lead (first name, E.164 WhatsApp, business type, leads a month, consent, UTMs).

nodes.name: Send welcome?
nodes.notes: Only people who ticked the separate, unticked consent box get a WhatsApp welcome (DPDP).

nodes.name: Stamp welcome
nodes.notes: Takes the timestamp right after the API call, so seconds_to_reply is honest.

nodes.name: Build pipeline row
nodes.notes: New lead: full row with stage New. Returning lead: updates only the kit fields, never the stage or first-contact times.

nodes.name: WhatsApp: alert Hemant
nodes.notes: Utility template to Hemant's personal WhatsApp (must be a different number from the business number).
